exposure: Anti-SARS-CoV-2-specific IgG and IgA antibody responses
cohort: 151 asymptomatic pregnant women admitted for childbirth or caesarean delivery to a university maternal hospital.
finding: The positive anti-SARS-CoV-2 serology poorly correlated with the confirmatory RT-PCR, suggesting that a SARS-CoV-2-PCR-based admission screening is more effective in preventing the spread of the disease.
